title.value: Intelligent Systems Engineering: How can intelligent systems revolutionise health care?
title.justification: The main focus of the paper is exploring how intelligent systems can transform healthcare delivery and management.
title.quote: Dr Narges Armanfard from McGill University and Mila Quebec AI Institute in Montreal, Canada, has set up iSMART Lab to develop intelligent computer systems that can support medical professionals.

extractions.description: The paper focuses on the development and implementation of intelligent systems and AI to revolutionize healthcare. It discusses the challenges faced by healthcare systems due to aging populations and highlights the iSMART Lab's efforts to address these through innovations in health monitoring technologies. The paper emphasizes AI in analyzing health data for better personal and professional healthcare management.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily addresses healthcare improvements through AI, which is not a central theme of ecological or climate sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Thanks to medical advancements and better lifestyle choices, humans are now living much longer than we used to.

primary_category.justification: The paper's emphasis is on healthcare improvements via intelligent systems, which do not directly relate to ecological or climate sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: Intelligent systems are innovative computer systems that can perceive and respond to the world around them. One key aspect of such systems is AI algorithms, which can analyse vast amounts of data in a short space of time.

primary_sub_category.justification: The specific focus on healthcare through intelligent systems does not align with any provided sub-categories related to ecological or climate sustainability.
primary_sub_category.quote: The projects we work on aim to transform the monitoring and management of health conditions.”

new_primary_category.justification: A new category focusing on the intersection of AI and healthcare enhancement is more appropriate given the paper's main discussions.
new_primary_category.quote: iSMART Lab is attempting to revolutionise how healthcare professionals and individuals monitor and manage their health.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: This new sub-category aligns with the detailed aspects of the research focused on AI applications in personal and professional healthcare settings.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: By analysing data from various sources, such as wearable devices, health records and lifestyle habits, these systems can provide personalised insights into an individual’s health.
